# LibreKO interface icons

Source: https://github.com/ZeusAFK/LibreKO

Revision: e5f0e4200fd42f69934f55557f92f2ee2ccfafde

Upstream paths: `Client/assets/ui/icons/system/*.svg`, unchanged copies.
Authors: ZeusAFK and the LibreKO contributors, as recorded in upstream history.
Upstream license: GNU Affero General Public License version 3; the complete
license accompanies these assets as `LICENSE.txt`. These assets are distributed
with their editable SVG sources. Upstream identifies `ui/icons/` as artwork
included in the repository, separately from installed-game content generated by
LibreKO-Assets. No converted proprietary client content is included here.

Included: bag, user, scroll, hammer, users-three, sliders, pin, combat-defence.
The LittleGod mapping is in `scripts/premium_theme.gd`. No upstream runtime code
was copied. The procedural 2D weapon effects are LittleGod implementation code;
upstream was examined as a reference for separating visual effects from combat.
